name: Miu
source:
A novice mage and Riana’s apprentice. Since one isn’t considered a full-fledged mage until they have a familiar, she works hard and diligently to raise her egg.
The protagonist is the first man she’s ever seen. She was abandoned in the forest shortly after birth and was found and raised by Riana. Her magic spells keep failing because she was born to a mage and a human, so her magical power is weak. Deep down, she wishes she could live as an ordinary girl.
